purpose: Bind every required Enformer comparison axis to an explicit biological source, leakage barrier, target construction, and genuinely independent grouping unit before model training or protected target access.
design_metadata_policy: Public study descriptions and sample names may be used only to freeze eligibility, contrasts, and nesting. Protected patient outcome metadata and all protected genomic target values remain unopened until the final three-seed release.
global_rules: A held-out chromosome is not an unseen biological intervention.
Technical replicates, assays, and time points from one cell line and research program are nested in one independent-group score.
No locus may be selected by the magnitude or direction of its protected treated-minus-control target.
Candidate and every baseline receive identical example IDs, masks, target transformations, and group labels.
Any absent source, extra group, source overlap, provenance drift, or underpowered axis forces ABSTAIN.

axes.group_construction: Score all chr8/chr9 loci within each registered biological group, then bootstrap group means.
axes.target_construction: Observed assay profile on the exact 114,688-bp central evaluation span.
axes.leakage_barrier: Test chromosomes never select checkpoints, architecture, target mapping, or thresholds.
axes.baseline_semantics: Frozen sequence-only Enformer at native context and exactly matched central bins.

axes.group_construction: A group must be simultaneously absent from gradient updates while its chr8/chr9 loci are also absent.
axes.target_construction: Observed PDAC-state assay profile, with no condition label inferred from genomic coordinates.
axes.leakage_barrier: Both biological group and chromosome must be held out; either holdout alone is insufficient.
axes.baseline_semantics: Frozen Enformer is scored without PDAC labels; the separately registered grouped state adapter is a required diagnostic comparator.

axes.group_construction: One residual score per registered biological line/donor; assays and loci are nested.
axes.target_construction: Signed PDAC-minus-reference profile residual; no nonnegative clipping.
axes.leakage_barrier: Only biologically valid state contrasts are materialized; unrelated lines are never fabricated into pairs.
axes.baseline_semantics: Sequence-only Enformer predicts the same sequence profile in both states, while the grouped adapter tests whether generic state conditioning explains the gain.

axes.group_construction: A named cell line is one group across all studies and assays.
axes.target_construction: Frozen classical-versus-basal regulatory-state labels and profiles; ambiguous lines are excluded before prediction.
axes.leakage_barrier: Cell-line identity is globally deduplicated and no test line may enter adaptation gradients.
axes.baseline_semantics: Enformer and the candidate share the same loci; only preregistered condition inputs may differ by model class.

axes.group_construction: Exactly four depositor-defined biological contexts are scored: KPC-2D, M1L, T3, and T23. Replicates, multiple interventions sharing a control, assays, and loci are nested inside context and never counted as independent groups.
axes.target_construction: Primary: signed H3K27ac treated-minus-vector/control residual at identical genomic bins. FOXA1 occupancy is diagnostic only because the official Enformer mouse head has no FOXA1 output.
axes.leakage_barrier: This axis claims within-study intervention transfer to unseen loci only; it is never described as an unseen experiment.
axes.baseline_semantics: Raw sequence-only Enformer has an exact zero residual for identical control/treatment DNA. The required grouped adapter uses the official mouse output head and the label-blind mean of all 107 official mouse H3K27ac targets; this is explicitly a generic chromatin prior, not a pancreas-specific target.

axes.group_construction: GSE301272 ATAC and GSE301284 H3K27ac are jointly nested inside the single L36pl context. GSE295354 contributes exactly AsPC1 and T3M4. Replicates and assays are averaged within context before the paired bootstrap.
axes.locus_selection: Use zero-hour KLF5 occupancy intersected with assay-supported bins and a frozen matched non-bound set; never filter by treated-minus-control magnitude or sign.
axes.target_construction: Signed asinh-scaled ATAC/H3K27ac treated-minus-control residual on identical bins; direction accuracy is computed within each context before contexts are compared.
axes.leakage_barrier: All three studies are absent from training, checkpoint selection, architecture design, and threshold tuning; protected target tracks require the post-training release.
axes.baseline_semantics: Raw Enformer receives the identical sequence in control and treated states and therefore has a registered zero residual. The grouped Enformer state adapter must also be reported as the condition-aware robustness comparator.

axes.group_construction: One score per patient; loci and modalities are nested within patient.
axes.target_construction: Primary EpCAM-positive treatment-naive PDAC accessibility with matched expression used only for the frozen cross-modal diagnostic.
axes.leakage_barrier: No download, SOFT metadata, outcome label, or target profile may open until all three validation-selected final checkpoints are cryptographically released.
axes.baseline_semantics: Candidate and Enformer use identical patient-blind genomic loci and target geometry.
